{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABZjJ_gg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhDJ5RU", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 47, "title": "Implement level-sensitive slave SH-2 HBlank and VBlank interrupts", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At `ac063ea6d1e423f6b738124d207f0613e40aa4c7`, `Bus::interrupt` returns no external request for the slave SH-2 (`src/bus.rs:419–433`). Raster events update blanking state and signal the master-facing SCU, but never supply the slave's separate raster interrupt inputs (`src/bus.rs:642–679`). Existing dual-CPU guests exercise FRT communication interrupts, so their success does not establish this behavior.

A slave program that waits for HBlank or VBlank interrupts cannot synchronize through the documented hardware path. This is an entirely missing guest-visible input, making it a higher priority than further refinement of already executing timing subsets.

## Expected outcome

Implement the standard board's DCC-to-slave raster interrupt path and integrate it with existing CPU interrupt arbitration, exception entry and hardware-time scheduling.

The authoritative contract is Sega's [STN-28 attachment, Dual CPU Usage Ver.1.1, §2.3](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/info/hon/stn28_1.htm):

- Slave HBlank IN uses IRL level 2, vector `0x41`.
- Slave VBlank IN uses IRL level 6, vector `0x43`.
- These are level signals asserted during their respective blank periods. Returning from an interrupt while its blank period continues permits another interrupt.
- This path comes through the DCC, independently of the master's SCU interrupt controller. Slave software controls acceptance through SR.I.

Use the SH7604 hardware manual §§4.4/4.6/4.7 and §5, including table 5.4 and §5.3.8, for acceptance, deferral, arbitration and autovectors. Use [VDP2 ST-058-R2 §§2.3–2.5](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp2/hon/p02_50.htm) for blanking/status distinctions. In particular, DISP=0 forces the software-visible VBLANK status bit high; that readback override must not fabricate a continuously asserted physical raster interrupt.

Preserve the existing raster phase conventions. Document any unspecified DCC sampling phase separately from specification-established behavior. This task does not require measured electrical waveforms or completion of half-line interlace timing.

## Context and reproduction

Static reproduction is decisive: `Bus::interrupt(Processor::Slave)` combines internal requests with an unconditional `None` external request. `Machine` already queries this function at CPU boundaries (`src/lib.rs:650–675`), and `OnChip::external_vector` already implements the standard autovector calculation (`src/onchip.rs:699–706`).

Implement only the missing slave raster path and necessary scheduling/reset integration. Keep SCU status, masks, acknowledgement, DMA triggers and master delivery independent. Slave acceptance must not clear a raster level or acknowledge a master SCU source. Resolve simultaneous raster and internal requests through the documented SH-2 priority rules.

Use original, permissively licensed guest code. Configure the slave's normal autovector mode explicitly in the diagnostic; do not invent board-vector behavior for unsupported configurations. Any evidence-backed correction to these AI-authored criteria must be documented with exact primary references and rationale and may be made autonomously.

The supplied snapshot contains no open task Issues. Current main CI is observed as in progress, which is neither a failure nor a passing result. Recent CD report, sound-memory and video-write increments remain useful regression evidence; none implements this omitted path.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Implement slave HBlank level 2/vector `0x41` and VBlank level 6/vector `0x43` from actual raster blanking state. Requests assert and deassert with the existing hardware-time events, independently of SCU IMS/IST and display enable. Preserve master behavior.
- [ ] Add independent native board vectors for before/at/after both blanking boundaries. Cover representative NTSC/PAL configurations, both PLL selections and supported interlace fields. Expected levels, vectors and deadlines must be source-authored from the documented contract and explicit raster conventions, rather than obtained from production helpers or captured emulator output.
- [ ] Prove level behavior: immediate return during an asserted interval permits repeated acceptance; masking an entire interval and unmasking after it ends produces no stale queued interrupt; unmasking during an interval permits acceptance. Exercise SR.I at relevant thresholds, simultaneous HBlank/VBlank selection and an internal FRT request above and at a competing external priority.
- [ ] Exercise real slave SLEEP wake, exception stack/vector accesses, RTE and delayed/control-transfer interrupt deferral. Include a pending bus transaction so adding raster inputs does not duplicate exception entry, memory effects or retired instructions during replay.
- [ ] Verify SCU independence by changing master masks/status and acknowledging master interrupts while the slave level remains asserted, and accepting slave interrupts while observing unchanged master pending state. Verify DISP=0 does not turn the forced TVSTAT VBLANK bit into a permanent slave request.
- [ ] Cover SSHOFF/SSHON, cold/system reset and clock-switch slave restart. Canceled CPU-boundary work must not reappear; a restarted and subsequently unmasked slave must observe the current live blanking level. Preserve shared RAM, backup and existing reset-domain contracts. Native traces and computed guest records must agree across advancement chunks `1/3/17/10000` and passive debugger inspection.
- [ ] Add a reproducible original MIT-licensed SH-2 diagnostic executed by both native `Machine` tests and production browser Wasm under `/saturn-rust/`. The master starts the slave through SMPC; the slave installs its handlers, computes distinguishable HBlank/VBlank records, demonstrates re-entry within a blank and returns to ordinary execution. Include changed guest arithmetic, masked/omitted-interrupt controls and repeated cold boots. Hosts may load media, advance execution and inspect results, but must not write running results or inject substitute interrupts.
- [ ] Show that restoring the inherited absent-slave-input behavior fails the independent native vectors and the same executing guest assertions. Register fixture reproduction and browser coverage in the existing workflow. Update the conformance matrix, architecture and validation record with exact primary references, actual results, assumptions and remaining deviations; correct affected stale claims without removing substantive coverage.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native and Wasm Clippy with `-D warnings`, registered guest/media reproduction checks, `sh scripts/build-web.sh` and the complete extended `npm run test:browser`. Preserve Star Collector, Prism Courier, Hardware Lab and existing CPU, DMA/DSP, video/audio/CD, input, backup, restart and privacy assertions without required skips.

This is a partial #17 increment. Remaining CPU/peripheral semantics, board arbitration/reset/timing, SCU/DSP, video/audio, CD/media/HLE, SMPC and comprehensive integration requirements remain mandatory. HLE interrupt initialization and half-line raster timing remain separate outstanding work. Commercial-game compatibility remains unverified; this change and green CI cannot establish umbrella completion.

## Optional validation

Extend the original Hardware Lab disc with a slave raster synchronization diagnostic if useful. No personal firmware, commercial media, physical console, human approval or live Pages inspection is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
